2026-10-31. A self-contained conditional transfer, not a new memory architecture.

1. Receiver and source contract

M is a finite stabilizer-code memory, L its logical space, B an arbitrary
finite persistent bath, V:L->M an encoding isometry, and Dec a FIXED CPTP
decoder. Full syndrome projectors are Pi_s. Exact initialization is V tensor
I_B, allowing arbitrary initial L-B-reference entanglement. Nothing acts on
the untouched reference. Diamond norms are unhalved and are on the joint L-B
channel, not on a bath assignment presumed independent of a logical input.

Ideal corrections occur at independent, exogenous Poisson clocks. A complete
correction proposal is a CPTP map with Kraus Q_j Pi_j (possibly a sum of
syndrome projectors), scalar on every encoded Pauli orbit before its Pauli
correction. The full-pattern or lumped-inactive completion must be specified;
this argument does not identify them with the original active-only jumps.

INPUT CERTIFICATE (Astra N881's indispensable ingredient). For a fixed ordered
schedule of corrector proposals and marked local fault supports A_c, there is
a good predicate G such that, for EVERY choice of a full-patch Pauli at EVERY
marked fault, every surviving correction/decoder Kraus record satisfies
 D_s E_final V = scalar * I_L.
The same G and fixed decoder work simultaneously for all Pauli histories,
including accumulated logical homology, not just current syndrome support.
For independent dominating fault clocks of rates lambda_c, assume
 P_dom(G fails) <= delta(T).
Goodness can be chosen downward closed in the marked fault set: if a larger
schedule is universally good, substituting identities makes any sub-schedule
good. This is not a pointwise-in-error failure statement.

The source's actual universal support, transient coverage, stopped-torus and
homology hypotheses remain required. The new argument does not prove its

2026-10-31. Solo investigation; no change to other assignments.

Consequential capability: preserve an unknown quantum state, including its
reference entanglement, for a size-growing lifetime using local autonomous
dynamics. The physical destination is low-dimensional hardware without a
global correction clock or a classical global decoder. A finite small-code
improvement, a supplied ideal gate, or another entropy floor is insufficient.

First try with strongest existing machinery:

* Synchronous 2D QCA: Dunneweber-Styliaris-Trivedi 2601.20818v3 gives the
  appropriate synchronous existence theorem. Continuous-time realization is
  outlined; its threshold transfer is not thereby supplied. Drechsler-Oreg-
  Aharonov 2610.05589v1 explicitly distinguishes periodic from fully autonomous
  memory and identifies that gap. Do not silently import a synchronous proof.
* Astra N881 supplies a stronger asynchronous universal Pauli-history support
  certificate in 4D, conditional on its actual probability/topology imports.
  Its quantum lift permits an arbitrary finite shared bath at fresh exogenous
  fault proposals. General local-generator robustness was obtained by modifying
  the physical generator with noise floors. Its completed correction channel
  differs from the original active-jump model.
* Conventional global autonomous recovery and fault-path techniques already
  protect a small code. They do not remove the scalable geometry, clock or
  continuous-bath issues. The finite five-qubit construction below is a test of
  a transfer, not the selected scalable technology.

Actual next obstruction: the physical native bath need not produce a fresh
state-independent Poisson fault stream. Merely bounding average event rates
is insufficient. Counting only jumps also ignores the no-jump evolution.

physical depolarizing floor. The proposed operation is a true quantum-jump
instrument with a syndrome-scalar no-jump evolution, bounded conditional
operator hazards, and a CP completion of the good-record bath map. Classical
thinning is used only to bound records, not asserted to be a physical mixture
